comment: Golden OTA manifest vectors (docs/ota/manifest.md). Generated by tools/ota_manifest.py make-vectors with a throwaway key that only signed these files; its kid 'test-only' is never trusted by firmware.

cases.name: valid
cases.note: Signed by the test key; image matches.

cases.name: tampered_payload
cases.note: Payload changed after signing.

cases.name: tampered_signature
cases.note: One bit of the signature flipped.

cases.name: alg_none
cases.note: Unsigned token claiming alg none.

cases.name: alg_hs256
cases.note: HMAC keyed with the public key (algorithm confusion).

cases.name: unknown_kid
cases.note: Validly signed, but names a key the device doesn't trust.

cases.name: wrong_typ
cases.note: A JWS that isn't a sārathi manifest.

cases.name: wrong_board
cases.note: Signed manifest for a different board.

cases.name: not_newer
cases.note: Replay of the running version (downgrade protection).

cases.name: too_large
cases.note: Image larger than the OTA slot.

cases.name: insecure_url
cases.note: Plain-HTTP download URL.

cases.name: seq_mismatch
cases.note: seq disagrees with version.

cases.name: missing_sha256
cases.note: Required field missing.

cases.name: schema_2
cases.note: Unknown schema version.

cases.name: prerelease_version
cases.note: Pre-release versions are never published as manifests.

cases.name: duplicate_member
cases.note: Payload JSON with a duplicate member.

cases.name: two_parts
cases.note: Not three parts.

cases.name: bad_base64
cases.note: Padding is not allowed in base64url.

cases.name: too_long
cases.note: Token over 2048 bytes.

cases.name: hash_mismatch
cases.note: Valid manifest; one bit of the image flipped.

cases.name: size_mismatch
cases.note: Valid manifest; image truncated.
